_comment: A fake Notion workspace. Edit this file and re-run `assistant ingest notion`.
Every page's last_edited_time defaults to this file's modification time, so
an edit here looks exactly like an edit in Notion: the ingest guard accepts
it, unchanged pages cost nothing (the content hash rejects them before any
model call), and a changed date reconciles onto the SAME calendar event
rather than creating a second one.
Body shorthand, expanded into real Notion block JSON by ops/mock_notion.py:
| a | b |     table row         ```           fenced code
v Toggle      toggle; indent its children by two spaces

pages.title: OS revision notes - demand paging
body: A page is loaded only when it is referenced, so the resident set grows to fit
the working set rather than the whole address space.
With a fault rate p of 0.001 and a 8ms fault, the effective access time is
> Thrashing is not a memory-size problem, it is a locality problem.
